tests.name: scenario:AHU-01 AHU_SEQ_V1 behaviour
tests.description: S7 AHU behaviour on the running SoftPLC (template AHU_SEQ_V1, timings from the template parameters). Commands through Modbus HR0 (bit0 START, bit1 STOP); faults / test values by PLC online write; every expectation on a mapped signal is checked through Modbus AND PLC online read-back (plc:* keys are PLC-only variables). StateTrace bits: 1 STARTING, 2 DAMPER OPENING, 3 FAN STARTING, 4 RUNNING, 5 STOPPING, 6 DAMPER CLOSING, 0 STOPPED, 9 FAULT.
